Price your trip

Every vehicle is priced by the hour, from $125 to $325, with its minimum shown up front. A 5-hour evening in the Executive Black Sprinter (seats 14) is $725 before tax — about $52 per person when the group splits it.

How much does a party bus or Sprinter cost in Scottsdale?

Every vehicle is booked by the hour, not by the mile. Published rates run from $125 to $325 an hour, and each one shows its minimum before you book. A 5-hour evening in the Executive Black Sprinter, which seats 14, comes to $725 before tax, about $52 a head once the group splits it.

What does it work out to per person?

Divide the fare by the seats. A 5-hour booking in the Executive Black Sprinter (14 seats) is about $52 a person; in the 56-Passenger Motorcoach it is about $29. You book the vehicle and never a seat, so the total never changes with headcount, and the fare is the same full or half empty.

How is the total calculated?

Your fare is the hourly rate times billable hours, and nothing else. Billable hours are the hours you book, less any free hours earned, never below the vehicle minimum of 4 to 5 hours. Tax of 8% is added at checkout and a 50% deposit confirms the date. There is no service fee, fuel surcharge or per-seat price.

Do prices change for Barrett-Jackson, the Phoenix Open, wedding season or prom?

The published hourly rate does not move with the calendar. What changes in peak weeks is availability: January auction week, the February golf tournament, spring wedding season and April prom nights sell out first, and vehicle minimums of 4 to 5 hours are held firmly. Book those dates four to eight weeks ahead through our reservations team.
